objective: Use typed call webhook status, direction, and disconnect reason values while removing the duplicate reason field.
acceptance_criteria: All call webhook status fields use WebhookCallStatus.
All call webhook direction fields use WebhookCallDirection.
Terminal call webhook disconnect fields use WebhookCallDisconnectReason.
CallFailedWebhookPayload and CallEndedWebhookPayload do not expose reason.
Every producer assigns approved enum constants inline without mapping helpers.
Focused tests and repository finalization pass.
allowed_paths: focused tests in each changed package
risks: Removing reason can break webhook consumers that still read it.
Lowercase status values can break consumers expecting uppercase call status values.
An incorrect inline mapping can hide the actual terminal cause.
rollback: Revert the call webhook enum migration and restore the reason fields as one change.
